regions.merged_text: God bless you Joseph and Winifred O'Donnell - you and yours. Many thanks for your prompt action in "preventing" further solicitude about your so-highly-commended cold remedy, "Brom-Quinin: I hardly took time to read directions - so, as early as possible for good results. Thanks be to God I feel that He must have some way prompted your charilable move I hope we all have the requisite good days befor the week is over; - you with out temperature and Fr. Sol. without his nose running away, etc. I looks better here already Deo gratias. - Time for matins and lauds.
